title: iPhone 14 Pro Hybrid Bumper Case
author: Mediocre_Maker
description:
iPhone 14 Pro Bumper Hybrid case with camera protection. The back glass is exposed which both feels nice and leaves it open for most Magsafe accessories. The camera protection and case are separate components to allow for no supports being needed and for colour customization. There are ribbed sections where you grip the phone that give it a unique texture.

Print the main case out of PETG (I have not tried PLA) and the camera ring out of any material you choose.

I recommend the super-tack build plate to avoid brims, but if you don't have one it will most likely work on a regular PEI sheet.
